title: Art Adventures

services.name: Kids Day Classes
services.desc: This can be thought of like childhood educational programming or a place for home schoolers to get their art education and be in a learning environment. We develop painting skills in acrylics and watercolour and also explore mediums like clay, needle felting, watercolour pencil crayons, mixed media and more! Hula Hooping, movement, walks in nature, games and storytelling activities are incorporated into the programming to break things up, connect with the group, and have some fun! We are located close to the air port park and take walks to the park for play on the playground and beach.
